newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CANOEING-CHEESEMAN WIDENS BERG MARATHON LEAD.
newsitem.headline: CANOEING-CHEESEMAN WIDENS BERG MARATHON LEAD.

text.p: Cheeseman proved himself a worthy leader of the 36th Berg River
Canoe Marathon by winning the third day's crucial time trial on
Cheeseman powered his way over the 17 km race against the
clock to extend his overall lead over second placed Donnie
Malherbe finished third on the day's stage just behind
Graham Bird who pulled himself up from seventh to fifth.
Bird, the national canoe marathon champion, trails Cheeseman
by almost 15 minutes with only Saturday's final stage still to
Cheeseman paddled the time trial element of the leg in one
hour nine minutes and five seconds -- one minute 18 seconds
faster than Bird and one minute 49 seconds ahead of Malherbe.
Cheeseman, a Gauteng doctor, went straight from the day's
race to reconnoitre Saturday's Kersfontein portage -- the last
major obstacle between him and a first Berg title.
Robbie Herreveld, who won the race for the sixth successive
time in 1996, is not racing this year.
Jean Wilson stayed firmly on course for her fifth title as
she won her third successive stage to widen her lead over second
placed Antje Malherbe to 10 minutes, 34 seconds.
1. Michael Cheeseman three hours 54 minutes 47 seconds
